description: Conservative Republican Member of Congress is seeking a Scheduler. Scheduling duties include preparing daily schedules and detailed itineraries, preparing monthly projected schedules, briefing the Member on scheduling activities, coordinating press/interviews with the Communications Director, and coordinating photo opportunities with constituents. Travel duties include making reservations for air travel, ground transportation, and lodging, understanding CODEL rules for international travel, and completing pre and post-travel paperwork. Mail/Invitations duties include reviewing mail and invitations, responding to invitations, maintaining records of invitations, and ensuring briefing materials for events. Administrative duties include overseeing front office operations, directly overseeing the Staff Assistant, acting as liaison for constituents and visitors, acting as liaison between the Member and other Members, committee staff, White House, and government offices, and performing other duties as assigned.
